verdict.rationale: There is a link to the official three.js editor (viewport-based scene editor) at threejs.org/editor, but the evidence pack gives no detail on inspector depth, prefab/asset workflows, or scene composition features that would make it a primary level-building tool for a technical artist — three.js is fundamentally a code-first library. Missing for 10: documentation of prefab/scene-composition workflows, inspector capabilities, hands-on evidence the editor is used as a primary production tool rather than a demo/debugging aid.
